question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
-- Final answer: problems where condition count exceeds solution count
WITH condition_counts AS (
    SELECT name, 
           SUM(condition_count) as total_condition_count
    FROM (
        SELECT name, version, 
               SUM(CASE WHEN non_stack_max_test_score < stack_test_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as condition_count
        FROM (
            SELECT name, version, step, 
                   MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as stack_test_score,
                   MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as non_stack_max_test_score
            FROM model_score
            GROUP BY name, version, step
        )
        GROUP BY name, version
    )
    GROUP BY name
),
solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT c.name
FROM condition_counts c
JOIN solution_counts s ON c.name = s.name
WHERE c.total_condition_count > s.solution_count
ORDER BY c.name
